title: Coordinate exact authorized dependency injection, durable state, restart reconstruction, and rollback

phases.objective: Activate one canonical authorized mount bundle through a factory-owned injection coordinator, require exact readback, register the data-only evidence durably, and expose route dependencies only after exact durable registration readback.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A canonical Authorized Mount Bundle plus a canonical durable injection-state registry
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact runtime dependency becomes resolvable only after injection Receipt, exact mount Readback, and durable state registration all bind to one identity.
steps: Construct the lifecycle without accessing SQL.
Create the canonical dependency-injection coordinator internally.
Inject the canonical bundle and produce exact mount Readback.
Register Receipt and Readback through the canonical durable registry.
Verify durable registration readback before activating route resolution.
Resolve the frozen runtime dependency only for the exact mount-readback digest.
assertions: No route dependency is available before durable registration succeeds.
A wrong or invalid readback digest returns an empty frozen dependency snapshot.
Registration failure rolls the in-memory dependency back before reporting failure.
No Route, Server, migration, provider, deployment, main, or Production surface is modified.

phases.objective: Bootstrap the lifecycle through live server composition only after the contract-local durable-state schema is promoted, authorized, applied, verified, and bound to a current runtime bundle.
blockers: The durable injection-state tables remain contract-local and unapplied.
No live schema-verification packet exists for the lifecycle registry.
No live server bootstrap supplies this lifecycle controller.
No Provider or worker authority is granted.

phases.objective: Reconstruct the exact injection after restart and make rollback close route resolution before durable commit, with explicit reconciliation for a durable unknown outcome.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: An active durable injection state and a separately reconstructed canonical Authorized Mount Bundle
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Restart preserves exact route identity; rollback removes route availability immediately, records durable rollback, rejects reactivation, and requires explicit reconciliation after a simulated durable deadlock.
steps: Read the active durable injection state through a new registry instance.
Resume the factory-owned coordinator with the canonical reconstructed bundle.
Verify the original mount-readback digest and runtime object identity.
Rollback the coordinator before attempting the durable rollback write.
Return an empty route dependency snapshot immediately.
Record the durable rollback or mark explicit reconciliation required on unknown outcome.
Reconcile the pending rollback without automatic retry.
Reject reactivation of the rolled-back injection identity.
assertions: Restart reconstruction does not consume mount authorization again.
The route is fail-closed before durable rollback commit.
A durable rollback failure leaves no active route dependency.
Explicit reconciliation clears the pending durable rollback state.

phases.objective: Observe one separately authorized non-production lifecycle bootstrap only after durable schema and runtime composition authority exist.
This repository-only lifecycle controller grants no live bootstrap, migration, Provider, deployment, main, or Production authority.
